profile.headline: FullStack Developer
profile.summary: Full Stack web developer who is passionate about solving problems and creating clean, effective, and well-structured applications. I find joy in collaborating with others to produce the highest quality product, and I excel in team leadership roles. I specialize in JavaScript, React, Node, Restful APIs, SQL, and many other back and front-end technologies.  My background in theatre arts has given me invaluable communication, emotional, and creative skills. These skills have helped shape my success as a developer, as well as my pursuit to be a kindhearted and thoughtful colleague. As a queer, black, woman in tech, I take pride in bridging the gap between marginalized communities and the accessibility into this field.

positions.title: Shift Lead
positions.description:
·   Managed employee’s shift times including clock punches, and work schedule 
·   Delegated tasks for the team throughout their shift and trained new team members in operations that contributed to the most efficient, dedicated and passionate team in that location’s history. 
·   Provided excellent customer service while multitasking in a fast paced environment that allowed the company to appeal to the customers and also uphold company values and regulations. 
·   Regulated product orders and inventory that helped the company save money. 
·   Maintained safety protocol for operations and was the most liked safety captain in a history of disliked captains.
positions.insights: Skills: Catering · Sales · Team Building · Operations Management · Team Leadership · Customer Satisfaction

positions.title: Assistant Manager
positions.description:
019 (Seattle, WA) | CORE FACILITATOR & ASSISTANT MANAGER | FREEHOLD THEATRE 
·   Supervised  theatre tour groups in daily performances and workshops at various correctional facilities.  
·   Ensured safety, teamwork, and overall high morale in an array of correctional facility units.   
·   Assisted Artistic Director in varying day to day tasks, including, managing creative teams, being point of contact for facilities, and creating tour workshop materials. 
·  Provided support for production designers in daily set up/break down and directed crew in unloading/loading tour trucks and was voted best supervisor on the job multiple years in a row.
positions.insights: Skills: Nonprofit Organizations · Training Facilitation · Administrative Assistance · Team Management · Marketing · Teaching

volunteerExperiences.description:
·   	Developed a 12-week program that utilized theatre therapy structure in aiding recovering addicts in their journey of recovery and social reintegration. 
·   	Originated and instructed weekly acting, writing and improvisation classes for up to 20 students that enhanced the quality of life for those participating. 
·   	Worked with Co-Producer on scheduling, funding, organizing, and communicating with Recovery Café about class times, locations, membership, progress of students, and budget, so that the majority of logistical work did not fall on the non profit we were collaborating with. 
·   	Headed marketing, sound, props, and other production elements of the program.

projects.title: LeftOvers
projects.description:
·   An app that allows users to post info about food they are offering to the community. 
·   This app was designed to give a user-friendly interface for those who would like to donate food to their community. It also utilizes Google Maps Geolocation to offer the food collector clear info about the location of the food.
Tools/Languages: HTML | CSS | Sequelize | Bootstrap | JavaScript | Node.js | Expess.js | MYSQL Handlebars.js | Google Maps Geolocation | restful API

projects.title: Mood Ring
projects.description:
·   An app that simulates a mood-ring and tracks how often the user is in that mood.  
·   Mood Ring was designed to give the user a fun way to virtually interact with their moods. The user is presented with different colors, representing moods, to choose from, and once they click on the color, they are directed to a page that presents them with a picture that has most of that color in it, and a funny quote alongside it. Mood Ring uses chart.js to track and render how often the user has clicked on a color, or ‘mood’.  
Tools/Languages: HTML | CSS | JavaScript | Chart.js | API
